senses.gloss:
तुमुल a.
1 Tumultuous, noisy;
Māl. 9. 3; Bg. 1. 13, 19.
--2 Fierce,
raging; R. 3. 57.
--3 Excited.
--4
Perplexed, confused; R. 5. 49.
--लः
[]
--लं
1 An uproar, a tumult, clang.
--2 A confused combat, melée.

तुम्र a. Ved.
1 Destroying,
defeating, killing.
--2 Impelling.
--3
Energetic, strong.
